fi-trains.note: Fintraffic rail: stream connected. Original observation times retained.

balloons.note: SondeHub balloons: stream connected. Original observation times retained.

satellites.note: Science satellites and space stations. Modeled positions; orbital elements cached six hours, rejected after 14 days.

denver-vehicles.note: Regional Transportation District. Actual reported positions; 7 old or untimestamped records omitted. Coverage varies by service and time of day. No position extrapolation.

lisbon-vehicles.note: Carris Metropolitana GPS; 0 old or untimestamped reports omitted.

bay-transit.note: Set SF511_API_KEY on the server to enable this feed.

sea-ferries.note: Set WSDOT_API_KEY on the server to enable actual ferry GPS positions.

world-ships?bbox=-10,35,0,45.note: Set AISSTREAM_API_KEY on the server to enable streamed ship positions. No vessel data is simulated.

world-wind?bbox=-10,35,0,45.note: Open-Meteo wind model / CC BY 4.0. Animated particles illustrate flow; they are not tracked air parcels. Visual speed is exaggerated.

world-clouds?bbox=-180,-85,180,85.note: NOAA global infrared cloud imagery · hourly frames. Coverage varies; playback is accelerated.

world-lightning?bbox=-180,-85,180,85.note: NOAA / Vaisala lightning density · 15-minute aggregates, not individual flashes. Coverage varies; playback is accelerated.

world-traffic?bbox=-9.3,38.6,-9,38.9.note: Set TOMTOM_API_KEY on the server for sampled road speeds.

mbta-vehicles.note: MBTA. Actual reported positions; 8 old or untimestamped records omitted. Coverage varies by service and time of day. No position extrapolation. Matching trips use GTFS route geometry when GPS is within 80 m; other reports retain raw positions.

discovery.note: Fresh reports within 50 km. Movement means changed coordinates between checks, not a prediction.

imageChecks.clouds: HTTP 200 image/png with PNG signature, browser ISO-Z timestamp format
imageChecks.lightning: HTTP 200 image/png with PNG signature, browser ISO-Z timestamp format
